title: Delegated Evidence Proxy + SLA Bundles: Fast-track SIG/CAIQ Responses for Midmarket
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Summary: Propose and run a pricing/packaging experiment that pairs a new 'Delegated Evidence Proxy' capability with tiered SLA Bundles (Bronze/Silver/Gold) to reduce time-to-contract for midmarket customers and reduce sales/solutions engineering lift when responding to SIG/CAIQ and customer attestations. The core idea is twofold: 1) Delegated Evidence Proxy — a lightweight product feature that allows Customers or Sales to opt into a curated minimal-evidence flow where Redwood acts as an evidence proxy to surface pre-validated artifacts (logs, audit reports, KMS integration screenshots) and auto-fill CAIQ sections with verified references. 2) SLA Bundles — paid tiers that guarantee faster curated evidence delivery, deeper artifact packages, or cryptographic attestations. We will experiment with price anchors and credits tied to SLA tiers to find the elasticity that maximizes deal velocity and revenue per deal.

Goals & success metrics:
- Reduce median time from security questionnaire request to completed response from ~14 days to <=3 days for customers choosing a bundle.
- Increase midmarket conversion rate by +6 percentage points in pilot segment.
- Reduce solutions engineering hours per deal by 40% (instrument via internal time-tracking and ticket volume).
- Understand price sensitivity: target ARPA uplift >= $6k/year for customers choosing Gold vs Bronze.

Experiment design:
- Control: existing manual SIG/CAIQ response process (no bundled SLA).
- Variant A (Bronze): Free/low-cost fast path. Auto-filled CAIQ with links to public docs + 48-72h evidence backfill SLA; limited artifact set.
- Variant B (Silver): Paid monthly fee. 72-hour evidence delivery with curated artifact pack (SOC snippets, network diagrams, basic KMS evidence). Includes 1 dedicated onramp call.
- Variant C (Gold): Premium price. 24-hour evidence delivery, full artifact pack, crypto-signed attestation option and prioritized legal/security review. Includes entitlements to longer-term evidence storage for audits.
- Randomized A/B assignment limited to a pilot cohort (North America, ARR 25k-250k, new deals only).

Instrumentation & dashboards:
- New console events: onboarding.security_request.created, onboarding.proxy_opt_in, onboarding.bundle_selected, onboarding.evidence_delivered, onboarding.ses_hours_logged.
- Dashboards: funnel from security_request -> completed_CAIG -> contract_signed; SLA compliance by tier; average SE hours per deal; uplift in ACV.
- Tracking: link to GA4 experiment and internal BigQuery dataset (dataset: onboarding_trials).

Architecture & implementation notes:
- Delegated Evidence Proxy will be an opt-in endpoint in the Console that maps CAIQ sections to curated evidence templates stored in our secure evidence store (S3 with KMS). Evidence templates are authored by Security and maintained in a hashed library with versioning.
- Proxy will produce a signed, time-stamped manifest linking artifact s3 URIs, hashes, and a Redwood signature to simplify customer verification. Signing uses existing HSM/KMS integration.
- Minimal UI: 'Fast Security Response' modal for Sales to capture customer consent and selected bundle. Backend flow: create ticket in Security Operations queue and trigger evidence provisioning lambda.
- Rollback: customers can request manual review. For any item flagged by Security as unsupported, flow will escalate to manual SE handoff (tracked with ENG ticket).

Acceptance criteria:
- Delegated Evidence Proxy MVP in Console with opt-in modal and backend artifact manifest generation.
- Three SLA tiers plumbed into billing system (Bronze/Silver/Gold) with experiment promo codes.
- Monitoring dashboard showing conversion, SLA compliance, and SE hours.
- Legal sign-off on proxy terms and customer consent flow.

Risks & mitigations:
- Risk: Customers view proxy as insufficient for enterprise audits -> Mitigation: clearly label Bronze as lightweight and ensure Gold includes crypto-signed attestations and storage for audits.
- Risk: Security workload spike -> Mitigation: caps on pilot enrollment and throttling; automated evidence templates to reduce manual work.
- Risk: Regulatory concerns (export controls, data residency) -> Mitigation: restrict artifact types and regionally scope pilot to NA only initially.
